result.title: ViDM: Efficient and Order-Robust Parallel Visual Decision Making
result.summary: Visual decision-making demands accurate judgments and timely responses. Yet for multiple questions sharing the same visual input, autoregressive multimodal large language models generate answers token by token, accumulating sequential decoding costs as question count grows and delaying completion of the decision set. Their predictions can also vary with question order. We introduce ViDM, which transforms multi-question visual inference into parallel decisions in a single forward pass, improving both accuracy and inference efficiency. ViDM organizes shared visual context, multiple questions, and question-specific decision slots into one sequence, reusing the native language-model head to produce all answer distributions simultaneously. A Decision-Query Mask aligns each decision query's direct attention with shared context and its corresponding question, while case-balanced multi-order training strengthens robustness to question reordering. Across nine benchmarks spanning image, multi-image, and video tasks, ViDM improves Qwen3.5-4B's average accuracy from 73.49% to 77.55% while achieving 8.4x the baseline's average end-to-end throughput. On GQA, where each evaluated image has 11.4 questions on average, the end-to-end speedup reaches 20.3x. ViDM also improves mean and worst-order accuracy while reducing order-induced variation across multiple benchmarks, with further validation on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and InternVL3.5-4B.

AI.brief_summary: ViDM 把共享视觉上下文、多个问题与问题专属决策槽组织进同一序列，在单次前向中并行产生全部答案分布，并用 Decision-Query Mask 与多顺序平衡训练提升准确率和对问题顺序的鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「parallel 生成」路线：以决策槽取代逐 token 自回归解码，其掩码如何限制各槽对视觉证据的取用、并行多题下的信息共享与顺序敏感性，可供核查 latent 并行推理状态与视觉证据筛选的设计。
